svg.title: Meridian Text 1.7B — decoder architecture, attention, feed-forward and training objective
svg.desc: Four-panel scientific diagram of the unchanged Qwen3 architecture: 28 pre-norm decoder layers, grouped-query attention with 16 query and eight key-value heads, QK normalization and rotary positions, a 6144-channel SwiGLU, and the local next-token adaptation recipe. Attention cells are schematic.
svg.text: Each KV head serves two query heads; shown for one representative group.
Document-level split → tokenize + EOS → right-pad batch
EOS remains supervised even when EOS = PAD.
mᵦ,ₜ = 1 for valid next-token labels; N = ∑ mᵦ,ₜ
Checkpoint includes model, tokenizer, config and training log.
No shared document IDs or text
Tensor grids and attention values are schematic; dimensions follow the published checkpoint configuration.
